champion.tips: ASHE TIPS AND TRICKS Frequently use your E to scout vision for your team. Shoot it through the enemies jungle to see which camps are up and to spot the enemy Jungler. Use your W to harass and poke the enemy whenever they walk outside of the minion wave. Whenever your Ultimate R is up, try to look for a pick. It is a great tool to setup your Jungler or to start skirmishes.
champion.builds: THE BEST ASHE BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR SUPPORT IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Ashe Support build, you should take Flash and Heal as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Arcane Comet as your keystone, followed by Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Scorch in the primary tree, as well as Cheap Shot and Ultimate Hunter in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Ability Haste in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Zaz'Zak's Realmspike as your first item, followed by Ionian Boots of Lucidity and Imperial Mandate. For your last 3 items, you should build Malignance, Axiom Arc and finish with Blackfire Torch. For the skill order, you want to stick with W - Q - E. Right now, this build has 47.4% winrate over 993 matches played. Optional Your second option for Ashe Support build would be to take Flash and Heal as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Hail of Blades as your keystone, Cheap Shot, Deep Ward and Ultimate Hunter in the primary tree, and Biscuit Delivery with Approach Velocity in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense. The items for the build are Bloodsong, which you should build first, followed by Ionian Boots of Lucidity as your second item and Umbral Glaive as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Imperial Mandate, Axiom Arc and Vigilant Wardstone. The skill order for this build is W - E - Q. In the current patch, this build has a 42.7% win rate over 478 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Heal as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Arcane Comet as your keystone, Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Scorch in the primary tree, and Cheap Shot with Ultimate Hunter in the secondary tree, as well as Ability Haste, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Bloodsong as your first item, then Ionian Boots of Lucidity as a second item and Umbral Glaive as a third item. You want to finish the build with Axiom Arc, Imperial Mandate and Vigilant Wardstone. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it W - Q - E. This build is currently sitting at a 42.3% win rate across 343 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Ashe Support build in the current patch, try Flash and Heal as your Summoner Spells, Press the Attack, Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Coup de Grace as your primary rune tree, and Cheap Shot with Ultimate Hunter as your secondary tree. Use Attack Speed, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Bloodsong as your first item, then finish Ionian Boots of Lucidity as your second item, and Umbral Glaive as third item. The last 3 options are Imperial Mandate, Axiom Arc and Serylda's Grudge. The ability order for this build is W - Q - E. As of the current patch, this build has a 50.0% win rate over 92 matches played. Situational Ashe Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Ashe build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Ashe runes page.
